title: Headway — Timetable Stringline Studio
description: Lay out a railway, run services down it, drag the strings to retime them, and let the analyser find every single-track meet.
concept: Headway is a working train-graph (Marey stringline) editor. You build a line station by station, mark which sections are single track, then add services with their own class, speed, dwell and stopping pattern. Every service is drawn as a string on a time-versus-distance chart you can drag sideways to retime, and the analyser flags head-on meets, overtakes and headway breaches in real time — with an auto-resolver that nudges departures until the diagram is clean. Finished plans export as a stringline PNG, a public timetable CSV, a JSON plan or a share link.
features: Line editor: add/rename/move stations by kilometre and toggle each section between single and double track
Service editor: class (local/express/freight), direction, departure, speed, dwell and a per-station stopping pattern
Drag any string sideways on the chart to retime a service, with arrow-key nudging and clone/delete
Clockface generator that repeats a service every N minutes to build a regular-interval timetable
Live conflict analyser — single-track meets, overtakes and minimum-headway breaches — plus a one-click auto-resolver
Generated public timetable view with passing times in brackets
Export stringline PNG, timetable CSV, plan JSON and a share link; autosaves to localStorage

interaction.mouse: Hover a string for a service card with its departure, arrival and nearest call; wheel zooms the time axis around the cursor
interaction.click: Click a string to select it, then drag sideways to retime; click empty chart to pan; panels edit stations, services and track type
interaction.touch: Drag a string to retime, drag the chart to pan, zoom with the +/− pills; panel moves below the chart on narrow screens
interaction.keyboard: ← / → nudge the selected service by a minute (Shift for five), D duplicates it, Delete removes it
